patch.value: Extend native list parity to pagination and bounded output contracts

Follow-up to pm-rust-p0no: current compatibility mode explicitly requires unbounded amount and cost. Implement limits, cursors, continuation fingerprints and output budgeting with full-envelope golden tests against the exact published PM CLI. Keep 100 percent coverage and maintainer publication guard.

Real TS and Rust CLIs match multi-page envelopes and continuation fingerprints on shared fixtures; Stale or mismatched cursors fail consistently; No item loss or repeated rows; Output omission and budget receipts match; Existing gates remain enforced

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: PR #58 full-projection follow-up: published --full additionally emits read_output alias/migration/budget diagnostics, including estimated_tokens. Native --full restores complete metadata with unchanged selection, but these output-policy diagnostics remain outside the current slice and are explicitly documented. Synthetic exact published read_output receipt captured in tests/fixtures/list-full-read-output-2026-10-2.json; original nine envelope comparisons remain exact and unchanged. Include full-projection output policy in this bounded-output/canonical-controls follow-up.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Inspect the published 2026.10.5 list contract and existing differential fixtures before implementing native pagination, cursor validation and bounded projection receipts. Preserve every existing release gate; add shared-fixture differential and randomized page-walk evidence.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Baseline: all eight existing list differential tests pass with the installed TS CLI 2026.10.5, including nine golden envelopes. Contract discovery: --after follows item identity and collapses subsequent envelope metadata into continuation_contract; it does not bind a snapshot. --output-cursor binds the projected row collection and rejects stale snapshots. Pagination tests will distinguish these contracts instead of claiming producer cursors refuse mutations.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Implemented producer paging, snapshot output continuations, full-output diagnostics and core triage budgets in the CLI and Workspace::list_page. Differential comparisons use complete stdout/stderr bytes and fixed clocks, with no field normalization. Original nine unbounded goldens remain unchanged on 2026.10.5. Additional tests exposed canonical-plus-legacy receipt precedence and final-page rebasing; both now have regression cases. Changelog regenerated via just changelog-full: unchanged because the documented generator selects closed items and this task must remain open.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Resume verification: producer and budget page walks match both published 2026.10.5 and native CLIs, including exact receipts. Concurrent mutation is now exercised through a separate native update process. Unicode surrogate-splitting compaction has a reproduced serialization gap tracked separately in pm-rust-8hkb; this task remains open pending orchestrator verification. Coverage gates remain at 100 percent in all four dimensions.

value.author: codex-sol

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Windows CI follow-up: full run 37287014816 log retrieved. All three failures first differ inside producer next_cursor fingerprints; preceding rows, row counts and after-id/index values match. Budget snapshot continuation and stale-refusal tests pass on Windows. Investigating canonical tracker-root representation in the native query hash before changing product or harness; no tests will be skipped and no GitHub replies will be posted.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Root cause confirmed as a native product bug, not a fixture artifact: Rust canonicalize adds the Windows verbatim namespace prefix to pmRoot; published SDK resolvePmRoot uses Node path.resolve/path.join and hashes the ordinary drive or UNC spelling. All three Windows failures first differ inside next_cursor.fingerprint after identical rows/counts; snapshot cursors do not hash pmRoot and pass. Native query hashing now strips only the namespace prefix, preserving backslashes and filesystem paths. Portable drive/UNC regression tests include a hash measured with the actual published 2026.10.5 SDK. Differential harness and Windows test selection remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Local Windows-fix verification passed: just release-check completed all 184 tests in ordinary and instrumented runs, formatting, deny-warning clippy, private/public rustdoc, dependency and identity audit, pinned changelog verification. Coverage remains 100 percent: lines 2897/2897, functions 252/252, regions 4392/4392, branches 606/606. pm test pm-rust-ufzy --run --progress passed both linked commands: 15 real-CLI differential tests including randomized page walks, and 4 pagination unit tests including the new drive/UNC regression. Preparing the focused product fix for PR #60; Windows CI verification is next.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The first focused namespace fix passed local release-check and CI ubuntu/macOS/aggregate, but Windows run 37288712120 still fails at producer query fingerprints. Namespace removal alone is insufficient. Adding failure-only path-shape diagnostics (separator counts, case-insensitive equality, canonical equality and first differing character codes), without storing or logging paths, to identify the remaining Windows representation difference. All byte assertions remain intact.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Windows diagnostic evidence from run 37289539548: native canonical-root spelling has length 61 and no short-name alias; Node resolved-root spelling has length 58 and an 8.3 alias. Both use eight backslashes and zero forward slashes, so separator or budgeting changes cannot fix the difference. The product now retains resolved discovery spelling for query hashes separately from its canonical filesystem root. Temporary diagnostic instrumentation is removed and original exact byte assertions restored. New cross-platform discovery tests cover workspace, nested directory, file and direct tracker starts, plus typed empty-path refusal; no Windows tests are disabled.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Complete product fix is committed as 889e4bf and pushed to PR #60. Final just release-check passed 186 tests in ordinary and instrumented runs with all four coverage metrics at 100 percent, plus formatting, clippy, complete rustdoc, identity/dependency audit and pinned changelog check. pm test pm-rust-ufzy --run --progress passed all three linked commands: 15 real-CLI differential tests, 4 pagination unit tests, 3 workspace unit tests. Original differential harness is restored and no Windows tests are skipped. Watching Windows job in run 37290744982 to verify the complete namespace and short-alias correction.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Run 37290744982 exposed a macOS SDK-only regression from applying lexical spelling to every OS: CLI-to-CLI byte comparisons pass, but the SDK supplied temp-root alias hashes differently from the physical process working directory. Preserving Unix canonical query spelling restores previous SDK behavior; Windows query spelling remains resolved without short-name expansion. Portable tests exercise both platform choices directly, and every differential test still runs on Windows. Full release gate is being rerun for this correction.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Windows verification succeeded: Rust windows-latest in run 37290744982 passed the full suite, including all three previously failing pagination comparisons. This confirms that preserving the resolved short-name spelling and removing Rust namespace syntax fixes the native Windows divergence. Applying the resolved spelling only on Windows also restores the established Unix SDK/CLI path contract; final correction and receipts will be pushed after the refreshed local gate.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final platform correction passed just release-check: 187 tests in ordinary and instrumented runs; formatting, clippy, complete docs, identity/dependency audit, pinned changelog check all pass. Coverage stays 100 percent: lines 2928/2928, functions 256/256, regions 4427/4427, branches 610/610. pm test pm-rust-ufzy --run --progress passed all three exact linked commands (15 differential, 4 pagination unit, 4 workspace unit). Windows source fix was verified green in run 37290744982. Final commit preserves Unix canonical spelling and the verified Windows resolved spelling, then rechecks CI on the final head. Releasing claim and leaving the item open for orchestrator verification and the previously tracked boundaries; no GitHub replies or test exclusions were introduced.
